channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Michael Beasley | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Michael Beasley from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Josh Hart on Michael Beasley
item.description:
Josh Hart on Michael Beasley:

“I really think—at least that I’ve seen—he is the most talented person I’ve ever seen touch a basketball.”

Josh Hart on Michael Beasley, Apr 12, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Rich Paul on Michael Beasley
item.description:
“But talent also have to be able to value infrastructure too. And I know Michael Beasley personally, and he is a good dude. And I'm sure if he had the opportunity to do it all over again, he would take a different approach.”

Rich Paul on Michael Beasley, Sep 20, 2024. Source: Basketball Network.

item.title: Sean Marks on Michael Beasley
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Sean Marks on if KD spurred move for his friend Beasley:

“I don’t think it’s fair to call Kevin on every single thing we do…It’s well-documented these two are close but we’re looking at best available and talent. Michael certainly is that.”

Sean Marks on Michael Beasley, Jul 9, 2020. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Javale McGee on Michael Beasley
item.description:
JaVale McGee, with the quote of the night on birthday boy Michael Beasley:

“I call Michael Beasley a walking bucket. All he needs is some dishwater and a mop.”

Javale McGee on Michael Beasley, Jan 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @hmfaigen.

item.title: Luke Walton on Michael Beasley
item.description:
Los Angeles Lakers coach Luke Walton used his pregame media remarks before tipoff against the Memphis Grizzlies to send a message to his grieving player.

“I just wanted to send our love, our thoughts and our prayers to Michael Beasley and his family,”

Luke Walton on Michael Beasley, Dec 24, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Michael Beasley
item.description:
#Lakers GM Rob Pelinka on Michael Beasley:

“Coming off one of the finest years of his career, we think Michael is poised to have a very exciting and strong season for us.”

Rob Pelinka on Michael Beasley, Jul 23, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Michael Beasley
item.description:
#Lakers GM Rob Pelinka on Michael Beasley:

“Michael adds another component of versatility to our deep roster. His length and ability to guard multiple positions, stretch the floor, play-make and create his own shot are all essential characteristics for us.”

Rob Pelinka on Michael Beasley, Jul 23, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Javale McGee on Michael Beasley
item.description:
JaVale McGee on the Lakers signing Michael Beasley:

“He's going to have a huge impact on the team. He's a long guy and a pure scorer and he's a great guy. I'm actually good friends with Michael Beasley and the fact that he's coming now, this season is going to be amazing.”

Javale McGee on Michael Beasley, Jul 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @ArashMarkazi.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Michael Beasley
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Spoelstra on Michael Beasley's criticism of him:

“Jeez Beas you threw me under the bus man. We all root for Michael. He's one of the guys you like having around.”

Erik Spoelstra on Michael Beasley, Jan 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Michael Beasley
item.description:
Jason Lieser:Erik Spoelstra on Michael Beasley:

“We always will root for Mike. I'll continue to text him. Sometimes he doesn't text back.”

Erik Spoelstra on Michael Beasley, Mar 7, 2016. Source: Twitter @JasonLieser.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Michael Beasley
item.description:
“He was choking me and I tried to get free. That’s it. I don’t know why that happened. It was just a dirty play. I tried to separate but he’s strong. “You have to stand for yourself and get separated. Michael helped and separated us. I feel sorry for him because he got ejected. He was a true teammate and he helped me. I would do the same thing. It’s hard when the big guy is going against a point guard.”

Goran Dragic on Michael Beasley, Apr 4, 2013. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Lance Blanks on Michael Beasley
item.description:
Paul Coro:Blanks on Beasley:

“It's a fresh start for us & a fresh start for him. We aren't afraid of what he's experienced. We want to embrace that.”

Lance Blanks on Michael Beasley, Jul 20, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Norm Nixon on Michael Beasley
item.description:
“Michael is a great kid. A lot of the problems he had were because of who was surrounding him. Sometimes, you have to eliminate those distractions.”

Norm Nixon on Michael Beasley, Jul 7, 2012. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Stephen Jackson on Michael Beasley
item.description:
BucksStephen Jackson on guarding Beasley:

“He's one of those guys that you know he's going left and he still gets left.”

Stephen Jackson on Michael Beasley, Dec 28, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Norm Nixon on Michael Beasley
item.description:
“You have seen Michael’s talent, I don’t think there’s a question about the talent,”

Norm Nixon on Michael Beasley, Oct 24, 2011. Source: Minneapolis Star-Tribune.

item.title: David Kahn on Michael Beasley, Kevin Love
item.description:
“Michael Beasley needs to have a huge last third of the season when he comes back from his (injured) ankle. Kevin Love needs to adopt the mantle of becoming a team leader now that he's an All-Star. Wayne Ellington needs to become more consistent. Same for Darko Milicic; I'm expecting more consistency out of him.”

David Kahn on Michael Beasley, Kevin Love, Feb 17, 2011. Source: St. Paul Pioneer Press.

item.title: Metta World Peace on LeBron James, Michael Beasley
item.description:
“Beasley's actually a better shooter than LeBron, but the smarts are not there. He's talking so much trash instead of worrying about the game. He needs to become a winner.”

Metta World Peace on LeBron James, Michael Beasley, Nov 21, 2010. Source: St. Paul Pioneer Press.

item.title: Mario Chalmers on Michael Beasley
item.description:
Kevin Arnovitz:Chalmers on what he misses most about Beasley:

“He could take a little bit of the blame. Someone I could always be in trouble with.”

Mario Chalmers on Michael Beasley, Nov 1, 2010. Source: Twitter.
